SELECT /* LGVATT20020.retrieveRequestEnableTimeCheck */
CASE WHEN SYSDATE < rs.limit_date THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS request_enable_flag /* 수정요청가능여부 */
, TO_CHAR(rs.limit_date, 'HH24:MI') AS request_limit_date /* 수정요청마감시간 */ FROM (SELECT lgvatt_common_pkg.get_att_close_time(NVL(#{subsidiaryCode}, #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode}), 'UPD_REQ', TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{yyyymmdd}, '/', ''), 'DDMMYYYY')) AS limit_date /* 요청가능 시간 */ FROM dual ) rs

,(SELECT CASE WHEN lgvatt_common_pkg.get_idcard_inout_time(ar.subsidiary_code, ar.employee_no, ar.time_and_attendance_date, 'IN' ) >= TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(ar.time_and_attendance_date, 'YYYYMMDD')||ar.work_start_time, 'YYYYMMDDHH24:MI') + INTERVAL '-5' MINUTE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END FROM dual) AS in_time_red_flag /* 출근시간 적색표시여부 */ ,(SELECT CASE WHEN lgvatt_common_pkg.get_idcard_inout_time(ar.subsidiary_code, ar.employee_no, ar.time_and_attendance_date, 'OUT') < TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(ar.time_and_attendance_date, 'YYYYMMDD')||ar.work_start_time, 'YYYYMMDDHH24:MI')+TO_DSINTERVAL(DECODE(ar.shift_type_code, '1A', '0 09:00:00', '0 12:00:00')) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END FROM dual) AS out_time_red_flag /* 퇴근시간 적색표시여부 */
,ac.attendance_days AS attend_days
FROM tb_att_result_n ar /* 실적근태 */ , tb_att_code_c ac /* 근태코드 */ WHERE ar.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND ar.employee_no = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.employeeNo} AND ar.time_and_attendance_date = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{attendanceYyyymmdd}, '/', ''), 'DDMMYYYY') AND ac.subsidiary_code = ar.subsidiary_code AND ac.time_and_attendance_code = ar.time_and_attendance_code ORDER BY ar.time_and_attendance_date

mapper.select: SELECT /* LGVATT20020.retrieveAnualLeaveUseFlag */ aur.employee_no , DECODE(COUNT(1), 0, 'N', 'Y') AS anual_leave_use_flag FROM tb_att_update_req_n aur WHERE aur.approval_request_id = #{requestMasterId} AND aur.request_code = #{requestCode} AND aur.time_and_attendance_code in ('HL', 'HL_FN', 'HL_SN', 'AL') /* 연차, 반일년차 */ GROUP BY aur.employee_no
